jobs.description: Data Analyst at BridgeLoyalty CEM LLP, a service industry company specializing in Customer Experience Management. Responsible for building interactive dashboards, automating reporting workflows, conducting market research analytics, and delivering data-driven insights across business units.
responsibilities: Build and maintain interactive Power BI dashboards for operational and management reporting
Automate data collection, reporting workflows, and MIS processes using Excel, Google Sheets, and Apps Script
Conduct market research analytics and customer experience data analysis to support business decisions
Design and implement data pipelines and ETL workflows to consolidate data from multiple sources
Create automated survey tools and data collection platforms using Google Forms and Apps Script
Prepare regular MIS reports, performance dashboards, and business intelligence summaries for leadership
Leverage AI-powered tools to accelerate analysis, automate repetitive tasks, and deliver scalable solutions
achievements: Automated weekly and monthly MIS reporting, reducing manual effort by over 70%
Built 20+ interactive dashboards and automated reports deployed across the organization
Designed data collection automation tools that improved data accuracy and team efficiency
Implemented AI-assisted analytics workflows to deliver faster, scalable business insights
